gloss: order, circumstances; as soon as; depending on

definitions.explanation: The order of events or how things came about.
Used as a suffix meaning 'depending on' or 'up to'.
Used with verb stem to mean 'as soon as' or 'immediately upon'.

examples.japanese: ⟦そういう→そういう：09579_souiu⟧{次第|しだい}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{事|こと}→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{次第|しだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please explain the circumstances of the matter.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{至|いた}った→至る：02009_itaru⟧{次第|しだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦お{話|はな}しします→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I will explain in detail the circumstances that led to this.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧{次第|しだい}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The result depends on your effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧{次第|しだい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えます→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I'll change my plans depending on the weather.

examples.japanese: ⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦あなた→あなた：02565_anata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}り→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧{次第|しだい}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Whether you can pass or not depends on your efforts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{届|とど}き→届く：00899_todoku⟧{次第|しだい}、ご⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I will contact you as soon as it arrives.
examples.notes: Verb stem + {次第|しだい} = as soon as

examples.japanese: ⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧{次第|しだい}お⟦{知|し}らせします→知らせる：01208_shiraseru⟧。
examples.english: I will let you know as soon as I find out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わり→終わる：00567_owaru⟧{次第|しだい}、⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦しましょう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's depart as soon as preparations are finished.

notes:
{次第|しだい} has multiple uses as both a noun and suffix.

USAGE:
- ⟦{事|こと}→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{次第|しだい} (circumstances, how things came about)
- {次第|しだい}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ (depending on circumstances)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧{次第|しだい} (depending on the weather)
- ⟦あなた→あなた：02565_anata⟧{次第|しだい} (up to you)
- ⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧{次第|しだい} (depends on how you feel)
- ⟦{届|とど}き→届く：00899_todoku⟧{次第|しだい} (as soon as it arrives)
- ⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧{次第|しだい} (as soon as I find out)
- ⟦{終|お}わり→終わる：00567_owaru⟧{次第|しだい} (as soon as it ends)

REGISTER: Somewhat formal, common in business and written Japanese.
